name: Daily trend portfolio: 50-day breakout with a 200-day filter
source: Andreas Clenow, 'Following the Trend' (2013), core system (breakout in the direction of a long average, ATR stops); exits as the Turtle traders' (20-day opposite extreme). Evidence for the family: Hurst, Ooi and Pedersen, 'A Century of Evidence on Trend-Following Investing', AQR, 2017.
notes: Written 30 Oct 2026 before any run (tools/replay/RULES.md, 'Daily trend portfolio'). Choices: Clenow filters with 50/100-day averages and trails 3 ATR; this uses a 200-day simple average, a 2 x ATR(20) initial stop and the 20-day opposite extreme as the trail, fixed now. The breakout is a daily CLOSE beyond the 50 days before the last finished candle. One position per market, held overnight; swaps charged. Meant to run on ten markets at once.
